test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X, Y and Z are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides. C sits third to the left of W. C sits at one of the corners. A does not sit at any of the corners. Y sits second to the right of A. A is not an immediate neighbour of C. Only three people sit between B and D. B is an immediate neighbour of Z. B does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

Who sits second to the left of Y?
solution:
**Given: **

A, B, C, D, W, X, Y and Z are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides.

**Solution:**

(1) C sits at one of the corners.

(2) C sits third to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/211bec06261ad48c0da84692e5652bbd8c9d166e3cea367a412ca3e8628f6a77.png] 

(3) A does not sit at any of the corners.

(4) A is not an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2262a010adc1254adc4934288fb00b5e301146b9f369b3c3e2b55683000f4f7.png] 

(5) Y sits second to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a92d576d54cfa3363b073364e94227e725e2c56124f9be64c4ad948f45af4a.png] 

(6) Only three people sit between B and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd6fa86436f6d71e010d634842fd5ff9826a6d180541cd7b1920f8dd016875fd.png] 

(7) B is an immediate neighbour of Z.

 
• It is possible only in Case 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b80e8e67cd8fee49c10338c689038428f2b4faca1d3ab1fceae215e8dc8d1bb8.png] 

(8) X will be sit on unoccupied seat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebdddf9c50bcec008c8a903649374d3a04faf681edba4678811cada1f2d7a3c4.png] 

Here, A sits second to the left of Y.

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
